files.picker.confirm.description: Confirm button of the web destination-folder picker (title reuses files.share_target.pick_folder_title): uploads the picked files into the selected folder. Shown when an upload starts from a non-folder context (global search results).

files.picker.selected_hint.description: Helper line under the folder list of the web destination-folder picker. {path} = the selected folder's breadcrumb path built like files.search.result_path (e.g. 'All files › Contracts').
